title: MINORBENCH: A HAND-BUILT BENCHMARK FOR CONTENT-BASED RISKS FOR CHILDREN

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM refusal rates on the MinorBench dataset, which contains child-unsafe queries across categories like danger, sexual content, profanities, self-harm, and substance use, testing how models handle risky interactions from minors under varying system prompts.

Measuring the refusal rates of LLMs when presented with queries from a child's perspective that promote discrimination, harassment, or violence based on protected attributes (e.g., asking for permission to use racial slurs).
